messages:
maria (Support): Customer S-4821 says Admin Console returned success but their free-trial top-up (100 credits) never appeared in account. Tried twice.
kevin (Eng): Can you paste the request_id / tenant_id and approx time?
maria (Support): request_id=rid_0a9f3b, tenant=acct_98765, around 2026-02-27T14:12:10Z. Console showed 200 and toast :white_check_mark: but balance still 0.
priya (Backoffice): I pulled grant-processor logs for acct_98765. There's an idempotency tombstone check hitting no-op path. log snippet:
```
INFO grant-processor: apply_grant request_id=rid_0a9f3b tenant=acct_98765 amount=100
WARN idempotency: tombstone found for key=grant:acct_98765:promo_abc123 status=NO_OP
INFO grant-processor: skipping write, responding 200
```
maria (Support): So console gets 200 but worker skipped? Customer sees nothing. :grimacing:
kevin (Eng): That tombstone looks suspicious. Could be stale tombstone from a previous failed write that left proof-of-attempt but no DB row.
aj (SRE): Can you reproduce locally with the same idempotency key? priya, do we log the payload for tombstone creation?
priya (Backoffice): We don't persist full payload, only key + status. But I can attempt a repro: curl the admin API with the same idempotency key and see response and DB.
kevin (Eng): Repro steps we should run:
1) curl to admin-topup endpoint with X-Idempotency-Key=grant:acct_98765:promo_abc123
2) check grants table for row
3) check tombstone table for key
Example:
```
curl -X POST https://admin-console.internal/api/v1/topup \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
  -H 'X-Idempotency-Key: grant:acct_98765:promo_abc123' \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"acct_98765","amount":100,"reason":"promo"}'
```
kevin (Eng): If you get 200 but no row, run this rails console snippet to inspect:
```
# rails c
t = Tenant.find_by(id: 'acct_98765')
Grant.where(tenant: t).order(created_at: :desc).limit(5).each { |g| puts g.attributes }
Tombstone.find_by(key: 'grant:acct_98765:promo_abc123')&.attributes
```
priya (Backoffice): Ran the curl repro on staging: same behavior. Tombstone row exists, no grant row. Looks like tombstone was inserted before write completed (race on commit) — we return success to caller to satisfy idempotency but never wrote grant.
maria (Support): Customer impacted = 1 trial user, urgent to restore credits and make fix. They already escalated.
aj (SRE): Short-term mitigation: manual grant insert + audit entry, then clear tombstone. priya, can you provide SQL to do that safely?
priya (Backoffice): Yes. Steps (manual safe path):
1) insert grant row if missing
2) insert audit/grant_events
3) delete tombstone
SQL (replace values):
```
BEGIN;
INSERT INTO grants (tenant_id, amount, reason, created_at, idempotency_key)
SELECT 'acct_98765', 100, 'promo_abc123_manual_restore', now(), 'grant:acct_98765:promo_abc123'
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM grants WHERE tenant_id='acct_98765' AND idempotency_key='grant:acct_98765:promo_abc123');
INSERT INTO grant_events (tenant_id, event_type, payload, created_at) VALUES ('acct_98765','restored','{"by":"support","ticket":"S-4821"}', now());
DELETE FROM tombstones WHERE key='grant:acct_98765:promo_abc123';
COMMIT;
```
kevin (Eng): We'll write a backfill job to safely reconcile tombstones -> missing grants. For now, support can apply the manual SQL if legal/team OK. Priya, can you run it for this tenant and paste audit id?
priya (Backoffice): Running now on prod (with db-admin): audit_id=ae-7742. Executed, customer balance shows 100 now. Customer notified. :tada:
maria (Support): Customer confirmed credits visible and can start trial. Thank you! I'll close the support ticket after follow-up.
kevin (Eng): Root cause assessment: race in grant-processor between tombstone insert and grant write. Patch idea: change flow to write grant first, then tombstone as indicator, or use DB transaction with unique constraint enforcement and proper idempotency semantics.
aj (SRE): Also add an alert when tombstone exists without grant for >5m for a tenant. That would catch regressions.
priya (Backoffice): I'll open PR with fix + reconciliation job. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/backoffice/pull/432 (draft). Includes migration to add tombstone->grant periodic reconcile and a small metric.
kevin (Eng): Nice. Can we also add a console-side hint: when action returns 200 but tombstone present -> show pending state rather than success? UX change tracked in product ticket.
maria (Support): Filed product ticket P-1099 and linked S-4821. Thanks all :pray:
grant-bot: grant-processor job grant-processor-v2 restarted at 2026-02-27T18:30:00Z by aj (SRE).
aj (SRE): Will monitor metrics for 24h and follow up in #incidents if anything else crops up. :eyes:
